pairs: Groom to Bride: How beautiful you are,
my love, how beautiful you are!
Your eyes are those of a dove,
except for what is hidden within.
Capilli tui sicut greges caprarum quæ ascenderunt de monte Galaad.
Your hair is like flocks of goats, which ascend along the mountain of Gilead.
Dentes tui sicut greges tonsarum quæ ascenderunt de lavacro;
Your teeth are like flocks of shorn sheep, which ascend from the washing,
each one with its identical twin,
et sterilis non est inter eas.
and not one among them is barren.
Your lips are like a scarlet ribbon,
except for what is hidden within.
Your neck is like the tower of David,
a thousand shields are hanging from it,
all the armor of the strong.
Duo ubera tua sicut duo hinnuli,
Your two breasts are like two young does,
capreæ gemelli, qui pascuntur in liliis.
twins that pasture among the lilies.
I will go to the mountain of myrrh
and to the hill of frankincense.
et macula non est in te.
and there is no blemish in you.
You shall be crowned at the head of Amana,
vulnerasti cor meum in uno oculorum tuorum,
You have wounded my heart with one look of your eyes,
et in uno crine colli tui.
and with one lock of hair on your neck.
Your breasts are more beautiful than wine,
et odor unguentorum tuorum super omnia aromata.
and the fragrance of your ointments is above all aromatic oils.
honey and milk are under your tongue.
et odor vestimentorum tuorum sicut odor thuris.
And the fragrance of your garments is like the odor of frankincense.
An enclosed garden is my sister,
You send forth a paradise of pomegranates along with the fruits of the orchard:
with all the trees of Lebanon;
The fountain of the gardens is a well of living waters,
Send a breeze through my garden,
